title: One-sided randomized decision in time
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, let $L$ be a language of Boolean strings, and let $T:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$. On every input $x$, the machine halts within $T(|x|)$ steps. If $x\in L$, it outputs true with probability at least $2/3$; if $x\notin L$, then for every choice string of length $T(|x|)$ it outputs the one-symbol string false.
